references.text: The verse describing the original division of the spoils into two halves - one for the soldiers and one for the rest of the people of Israel
Describes that Moses was to take one out of fifty from the half belonging to the children of Israel and give it to the Levites
Summarizes that Moses took one out of fifty from the half belonging to the children of Israel, both of people and animals, and gave them to the Levites
Joshua instructs the tribes to share the war spoils with their brothers, a similar principle regarding the distribution of war spoils
David establishes a similar rule for equal sharing between those who fight and those who stay behind with the equipment
